notes:
Lead profile: early-stage fintech (series A, stealth payments/reconciliation product). Using hosted API to prototype chat assistant and embeddings-based transaction search. Security is a gating factor — SOC2 docs and SSO/IdP are early asks. VPC/on-prem curiosity flagged for long-term (9-12mo), but starting hosted.

Use-case detail: - Chat: customer support assistant for merchant support reps (context window ~800 tokens typical). - Embeddings: fast vector search across transaction metadata for reconciliation and dispute triage. - Reranking: lightweight model to rerank transaction anomaly candidates from heuristics.

Tech targets: p50 latency <150ms for short chat replies, p95 <350ms; embedding vector response <200ms; concurrency 15-25; cost sensitivity moderate (startup budget), expects clear per-token billing and quota alerts. Prefers smaller open models if quality comparable, but will evaluate Redwood-curated models.

Security/ops: Asked about SSO/SAML integration (Okta), audit logging for API usage, and minimum data retention/PII controls. Requested SOC2 Type II report and description of KMS/HSM support.

Quotes/notes from CTO (Maya Singh): 'We want to validate hosted first — fastest way to ship. If usage pattern requires predictable throughput or stricter isolation we'll discuss Dedicated/VPC down the road.'

Next steps: 1) Provide PoC API keys and example workspace + sample prompts by 2026-03-14. 2) Share SOC2 summary + SSO integration doc. 3) Schedule SE deep-dive (Priya) to test latency with their small dataset and run embedding recall tests.

Recommended internal actions: prioritize sending security artifact pack (SOC2 summary + SSO guide) and create sandbox project with pre-configured embeddings index and example chat flow. Track conversion: trial -> paid within 60 days if PoC meets latency/security checks.
use_case_summary: SMB fintech building merchant-facing support assistant and transaction search. Starts on hosted API (self-serve) but will re-evaluate Dedicated/VPC after initial traction. Early security asks: SOC2, SSO/Okta, audit logs. Performance target: low-latency chat and embeddings at modest concurrency.
